--- title: Statistical analysis with cross-validated classifiers subtitle: Bellbird mimicry author: Marcelo Araya-Salas date: "2026-11-19" toc: true toc-depth: 3 toc-location: left number-sections: true highlight-style: pygments format: html: df-print: kable code-fold: true code-tools: true css: qmd.css editor_options: chunk_output_type: console --- ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE) sketchy::load_packages(packages = c("knitr", "ggplot2", "viridis", "brms", "brmsish", "cowplot", "kableExtra")) theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14)) options(knitr.kable.NA = "") source("scripts/birdnet_cv_functions.R") models <- c("sympatric_and_allopatric", "sympatric") model_labels <- c(sympatric_and_allopatric = "Sympatric + allopatric", sympatric = "Sympatric only") allopatric_spp <- c("Psarocolius guatimozinus", "Pteroglossus erythropygius", "Ramphastos brevis") heterosp_sympatric <- setdiff(sympatric_spp, "Procnias tricarunculatus") common_names <- c( "Procnias tricarunculatus" = "Three-wattled Bellbird", "Psarocolius guatimozinus" = "Chestnut-headed Oropendola", "Psarocolius montezuma" = "Montezuma Oropendola", "Pteroglossus erythropygius" = "Pale-mandibled Aracari", "Pteroglossus torquatus" = "Collared Aracari", "Ramphastos brevis" = "Choco Toucan", "Ramphastos sulfuratus" = "Keel-billed Toucan", "Unassigned" = "Unassigned" ) cores <- 4; chains <- 4; iter <- 4000 fit_dir <- "./data/processed/cv_fits" dir.create(fit_dir, showWarnings = FALSE) # posterior predictive checks (density overlay and mean), by group if given custom_ppc <- function(fit, group = NULL, ndraws = 100) { pal <- scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = 0.3, end = 0.8, alpha = 0.5, option = "mako") if (!is.null(group) && group %in% names(fit$data)) { p <- list(pp_check(fit, ndraws = ndraws, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = group), pp_check(fit, ndraws = ndraws, type = "stat_grouped", stat = "mean", group = group)) } else { p <- list(pp_check(fit, ndraws = ndraws, type = "dens_overlay"), pp_check(fit, ndraws = ndraws, type = "stat", stat = "mean")) } plot_grid(plotlist = lapply(p, function(x) x + pal + theme_classic()), ncol = 2) } ci <- function(x, digits = 2) paste0(round(median(x), digits), " [95% UI: ", round(quantile(x, 0.025), digits), "–", round(quantile(x, 0.975), digits), "]") ``` ::: # Purpose {.unnumbered} - Repeat the analyses of the [statistical analysis](statistical_analysis.qmd) with the cross-validated BirdNET classifiers of the [model fitting](birdnet_model_fitting.qmd#cross-validation) report, instead of the classifiers trained in the BirdNET-Analyzer GUI - Compare the estimates obtained with both sets of classifiers The fits are saved in `data/processed/cv_fits/`. The original analysis and its fits are not modified. # Cross-validated classifiers ## Design - All training and test clips were pooled and split into 5 folds grouped by recording (all clips of a recording in the same fold) and stratified by species, seed 123 - For each fold, the classifiers were trained on the other 4 folds (early stopping on a random 20% of the training clips) and classified the held-out fold, so every clip has a prediction from a model that never heard its recording - Training and classification used a 400–12,000 Hz bandpass - Three hyperparameter configurations were compared: **A**, the settings of the GUI sympatric + allopatric model (2,048 hidden units, focal loss, mixup); **B**, the settings of the GUI sympatric-only model (256 hidden units, upsampling, mixup); and **C**, BirdNET defaults (linear classifier) - Selection rule, set before seeing the results: the highest out-of-fold macro-averaged AUPRC, separately for each classifier - Per-species thresholds maximize F1 on the out-of-fold predictions. A clip is assigned to its highest-confidence species if it reaches that species' threshold, otherwise it is unassigned - The focal bellbird clips are classified by the 5 fold models of the selected configuration: confidences are averaged across models (ensemble) and the out-of-fold thresholds are applied ## Comparison of configurations ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} folds <- read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, "folds.csv")) cmp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("A", "B", "C"), function(cf) do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { sc <- oof_scores(cf, m, folds) spp <- model_spp[[m]] thr <- optimal_thresholds(sc, spp) mt <- cv_metrics(sc, spp, thr) fm <- fold_metrics(sc, spp, thr) data.frame(Classifier = model_labels[[m]], Configuration = cf, AUPRC = mt$macro[["AUPRC"]], `AUPRC SD` = sd(fm$AUPRC), F1 = mt$macro[["F1"]], `F1 SD` = sd(fm$F1), Accuracy = mt$macro[["accuracy"]], check.names = FALSE) })))) cmp$Classifier <- factor(cmp$Classifier, levels = model_labels) best_cfg <- sapply(models, function(m) { d <- cmp[cmp$Classifier == model_labels[[m]], ] d$Configuration[order(-d$AUPRC, -d$F1)[1]] }) cmp$Selected <- ifelse(cmp$Configuration == best_cfg[match(cmp$Classifier, model_labels)], "✓", "") ggplot(cmp, aes(Configuration, AUPRC, color = Configuration)) + geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = AUPRC - `AUPRC SD`, ymax = AUPRC + `AUPRC SD`), size = 0.6, linewidth = 1) + facet_wrap(~ Classifier, scales = "free_y") + scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.8, guide = "none") + labs(y = "Out-of-fold macro AUPRC\n(mean ± SD across folds)") + theme(strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](statistical_analysis_cv_files/figure-html/cv comparison-1.png){width=960} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} kable(cmp[order(cmp$Classifier), ], digits = 3, row.names = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} |Classifier |Configuration | AUPRC| AUPRC SD| F1| F1 SD| Accuracy|Selected | 0.015| 0.901| | |Sympatric only |C | 0.991| 0.007| 0.947| 0.021| 0.920|✓ | ::: ::: ## Selected classifiers Out-of-fold performance by species of the selected configurations. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} oof <- lapply(setNames(models, models), function(m) read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, paste0("oof_predictions_", m, ".csv")), check.names = FALSE)) thr <- lapply(setNames(models, models), function(m) optimal_thresholds(oof[[m]], model_spp[[m]])) focal_pred <- lapply(setNames(models, models), function(m) read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, paste0("focal_predictions_", m, ".csv")), check.names = FALSE)) per_sp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { r <- cv_metrics(oof[[m]], model_spp[[m]], thr[[m]])$per_species data.frame(Classifier = paste0(model_labels[[m]], " (", best_cfg[[m]], ")"), r) })) names(per_sp) <- c("Classifier", "Species", "Precision", "Recall", "F1", "AUPRC", "Threshold", "Clips") kable(per_sp, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Out-of-fold confusion matrices (proportion of the clips of each species; numbers are clips): ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) { lv <- c(model_spp[[m]], "Unassigned") d <- as.data.frame(table(True = factor(oof[[m]]$true, levels = model_spp[[m]]), Predicted = factor(oof[[m]]$predicted, levels = lv))) d$Proportion <- d$Freq / ave(d$Freq, d$True, FUN = sum) d$Classifier <- paste0(model_labels[[m]], " (", best_cfg[[m]], ")") d })) cm$Classifier <- factor(cm$Classifier, levels = unique(cm$Classifier)) ggplot(cm, aes(Predicted, True, fill = Proportion)) + geom_tile(color = "white") + geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Freq > 0, Freq, ""), color = Proportion > 0.5), size = 3.5) + scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "black"), guide = "none") + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, limits = c(0, 1)) + facet_wrap(~ Classifier, scales = "free") + labs(x = "Predicted", y = "Vocalizing species") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](statistical_analysis_cv_files/figure-html/oof confusion-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: # Sympatric and allopatric species Is a heterospecific classification of the focal bellbird more often the sympatric species (a possible model) than its closely related allopatric relative (which it could never have heard)? Other bellbirds are the out-of-fold predictions of all bellbird clips used to train the classifiers (800 clips), instead of the 137 test clips of the original analysis. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} est <- readRDS("./data/processed/extended_selection_table_sympatric_and_allopatric_species.RDS") focal_meta <- data.frame(clip = est$sound.files, recording = attr(est, "check.res")$orig.sound.files) focal_meta <- focal_meta[est$source == "mimic_bellbird", ] recording_of <- function(clip) sub("\\.wav_[0-9]+$", "", clip) build <- function(m) { fp <- focal_pred[[m]] op <- oof[[m]][oof[[m]]$true == "Procnias tricarunculatus", ] rbind(data.frame(clip = fp$clip, recording = focal_meta$recording[match(fp$clip, focal_meta$clip)], predicted_sp = fp$predicted, vocalizing_type = "focal"), data.frame(clip = op$clip, recording = recording_of(op$clip), predicted_sp = op$predicted, vocalizing_type = "others")) } bb_sa <- build("sympatric_and_allopatric") bb_sa$vocalizing_type <- factor(bb_sa$vocalizing_type, levels = c("others", "focal")) kable(as.data.frame.matrix(table(`Classified as` = bb_sa$predicted_sp, bb_sa$vocalizing_type))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} | | others| focal| |:--------------------------|------:|-----:| |Procnias tricarunculatus | 761| 497| |Psarocolius guatimozinus | 1| 1| |Psarocolius montezuma | 4| 7| |Pteroglossus erythropygius | 1| 43| |Pteroglossus torquatus | 0| 161| |Ramphastos brevis | 1| 6| |Ramphastos sulfuratus | 2| 643| |Unassigned | 30| 302| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} het <- bb_sa[bb_sa$predicted_sp %in% c(heterosp_sympatric, allopatric_spp), ] het$genus <- factor(sub(" .*", "", het$predicted_sp), levels = c("Pteroglossus", "Psarocolius", "Ramphastos"), labels = c("Aracaris", "Oropendolas", "Toucans")) het$type <- factor(ifelse(het$predicted_sp %in% allopatric_spp, "Allopatric", "Sympatric"), levels = c("Sympatric", "Allopatric")) het$bird <- factor(ifelse(het$vocalizing_type == "focal", "Focal bellbird", "Other bellbirds"), levels = c("Other bellbirds", "Focal bellbird")) n_bird <- table(bb_sa$vocalizing_type) cnt <- as.data.frame(table(bird = het$bird, genus = het$genus, type = het$type)) cnt$Proportion <- cnt$Freq / as.numeric(n_bird[ifelse(cnt$bird == "Focal bellbird", "focal", "others")]) ggplot(cnt, aes(genus, Proportion, fill = type)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) + geom_text(aes(label = Freq), position = position_dodge(0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) + facet_wrap(~ bird) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(Sympatric = "#408AB4", Allopatric = "#7B4F9D")) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Vocalizations classified as", fill = NULL) + theme(strip.background = element_blank()) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](statistical_analysis_cv_files/figure-html/symp allo plot-1.png){width=864} ::: ::: ## Focal bellbird As in the original analysis: the probability that a heterospecific classification of the focal bellbird is the sympatric species rather than the allopatric one (0.5 if both were equally likely by chance), with the recording as a random effect. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} d1 <- bb_sa[bb_sa$predicted_sp %in% c(heterosp_sympatric, allopatric_spp), ] d1$mimic_type <- as.integer(d1$predicted_sp %in% heterosp_sympatric) priors1 <- c(prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "Intercept"), prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")) mod1 <- brm(mimic_type ~ 1 + (1 | recording), data = d1[d1$vocalizing_type == "focal", ], family = bernoulli(), prior = priors1, chains = chains, iter = iter, cores = cores, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99), seed = 123, file = file.path(fit_dir, "sympatric_allopatric_focal"), file_refit = "on_change") ``` ::: Probability that such a classification is the sympatric species: other bellbirds 0.77 [95% UI: 0.4–0.95], focal bellbird 0.95 [95% UI: 0.93–0.97]; odds ratio focal vs others 6.1 [95% UI: 1–30.5] ::: # Only sympatric species Is the focal bellbird classified as a heterospecific (instead of its own species) more often than other bellbirds? Unassigned clips are excluded, as in the original analysis. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} bb_s <- build("sympatric") bb_s$vocalizing_type <- factor(bb_s$vocalizing_type, levels = c("others", "focal")) kable(as.data.frame.matrix(table(`Classified as` = bb_s$predicted_sp, bb_s$vocalizing_type))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} | | others| focal| |:------------------------|------:|-----:| |Procnias tricarunculatus | 748| 473| |Psarocolius montezuma | 2| 14| |Pteroglossus torquatus | 0| 214| |Ramphastos sulfuratus | 4| 667| |Unassigned | 46| 292| ::: ```{.r .cell-code} d2 <- bb_s[bb_s$predicted_sp != "Unassigned", ] d2$prediction_type <- as.integer(d2$predicted_sp != "Procnias tricarunculatus") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} priors2 <- c(prior(normal(-3, 1), class = "Intercept"), prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"), prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")) mod2 <- brm(prediction_type ~ vocalizing_type + (1 | recording), data = d2, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors2, chains = chains, iter = iter, cores = cores, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth = 15), seed = 123, file = file.path(fit_dir, "sympatric_only"), file_refit = "on_change") ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} extended_summary(mod2, n.posterior = 1000, fill = mako(10)[8], trace.palette = mako, remove.intercepts = FALSE, highlight = TRUE, print.name = FALSE) ```

Unlike the original analysis, other bellbirds have a few heterospecific classifications, so the odds ratio is estimated from the data instead of being bounded by the prior ::: # Mimicry through time Daily proportions of the focal bellbird vocalizations assigned to each category by the cross-validated sympatric-only classifier. As in the original analysis, Montezuma Oropendola (14 clips) is not modeled. The original analysis used the GUI predictions without thresholds; here clips below their species' threshold are unassigned. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} rec_info <- read.table("./data/raw/Recording_dates_.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";") rec_info$date <- gsub("/", "-", rec_info$date) rec_info$date <- gsub("out", "ago", rec_info$date) rec_info$date <- gsub("set", "sep", rec_info$date) rec_info$date <- as.Date(rec_info$date, format = "%d-%b-%y") fp <- focal_pred$sympatric fp$recording <- focal_meta$recording[match(fp$clip, focal_meta$clip)] fp$date <- rec_info$date[match(fp$recording, rec_info$sound.files)] cat(sum(is.na(fp$date)), "clips without a recording date\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 20 clips without a recording date ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} fp <- fp[!is.na(fp$date), ] cats <- c("Procnias tricarunculatus", "Pteroglossus torquatus", "Ramphastos sulfuratus", "Unassigned") dat <- as.data.frame(table(date = fp$date, pred = factor(fp$predicted, levels = c(cats, "Psarocolius montezuma")))) names(dat)[3] <- "n" dat$date <- as.Date(as.character(dat$date)) dat$total <- ave(dat$n, dat$date, FUN = sum) dat <- dat[dat$pred %in% cats, ] dat$prop <- dat$n / dat$total dat$pred_common_name <- factor(common_names[as.character(dat$pred)], levels = common_names[cats]) dat$julian_day <- as.numeric(format(dat$date, "%j")) dat$obs <- factor(seq_len(nrow(dat))) kable(aggregate(n ~ pred_common_name, dat, sum), col.names = c("Category", "Clips")) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} |Category | Clips| |:----------------------|-----:| |Three-wattled Bellbird | 466| |Collared Aracari | 214| |Keel-billed Toucan | 662| |Unassigned | 284| ::: ::: Same model as the original analysis: binomial, Julian day with intercepts and slopes varying by category, and an observation-level random effect for overdispersion. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} priors3 <- c(prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"), prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"), prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")) mod3 <- brm(n | trials(total) ~ scale(julian_day) + (1 + scale(julian_day) | pred_common_name) + (1 | obs), family = binomial, data = dat, prior = priors3, chains = chains, cores = cores, iter = iter, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99), seed = 123, file = file.path(fit_dir, "mimicry_through_time"), file_refit = "on_change")
